name: Pope Army Airfield
description: Pope Army Airfield is an Air Force installation within Fort Liberty (formerly Fort Bragg), home to the 43rd Air Mobility Operations Group and supporting XVIII Airborne Corps airlift and joint special operations missions. Pope Field is an enclave on Army-controlled Fort Liberty — gate access, visitor passes, and many services depend on Fort Liberty access control points and MWR programs.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate. Non-DoD visitors must obtain a pass from the Fort Liberty All-American Visitor Control Center — not at Pope Field gates.

currentNotifications.title: Fort Liberty Gate Dependencies
currentNotifications.body: Pope Field (Gate 18 Manchester) is open Mon-Fri 0500-2100 and closed weekends and federal holidays. After-hours and weekend access to Pope requires routing through Fort Liberty gates. Verify gate status before travel — GPS may not account for gate closures.

gates.name: Gate 18 — Manchester Gate (Pope Field Main)
gates.notes: Primary access point for Pope Field. Closed weekends and federal holidays. Does not issue visitor passes — non-DoD visitors must obtain passes at the Fort Liberty All-American Visitor Control Center first.
gates.address: Manchester Rd, Pope Army Airfield, Fort Liberty, NC 28308

gates.name: All-American Gate (Fort Liberty ACP 5)
gates.notes: Primary Fort Liberty access point for visitors and after-hours entry. Non-DoD personnel without a valid DoD ID must use this gate to receive a visitor pass when VCC is closed (2100-0500).
gates.address: All American Fwy, Fort Liberty, NC 28310

gates.name: All-American Visitor Control Center (Fort Liberty VCC)
gates.notes: Required stop for all non-DoD visitors to Fort Liberty and Pope Field. Bring valid REAL ID, vehicle registration, and proof of insurance. AIE IV registration takes 2-5 minutes during VCC hours.
gates.address: 3550 All American Fwy, Bldg H-1575, Fort Liberty, NC 28310

gates.name: Knox Truck Plaza VCC (Commercial)
gates.notes: Commercial vendors and contractors use this VCC off Cook Street (ACP 16). Not for routine Pope Field visitor access.
gates.address: Cook St, Bldg K-1153, Fort Liberty, NC 28310

gates.name: Reilly Gate (Fort Liberty)
gates.notes: Fort Liberty gate providing alternate access to the Pope Field area. Valid installation pass or DoD ID required.

gates.name: Main Gate — Bragg Blvd (Fort Liberty)
gates.notes: Fort Liberty main gate on Bragg Blvd. Pope Field personnel may use any open Fort Liberty ACP with valid credentials; verify current gate status on the Fort Liberty gate information page.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement. Pope Field is on Fort Liberty — ensure your sponsor coordinates Fort Liberty gate access.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit and visit the Military Personnel Flight within required timelines. Attend the monthly M&FRC Newcomers Orientation on the third Wednesday. Medical in-processing is through Womack Army Medical Center, not an on-base Air Force clinic.

sections.title: Housing & Lodging
sections.body: Contact the Housing Office before arrival. Reserve temporary lodging early — check in at Moon Hall (Darby Loop) for Carolina Inn rooms on Pope Field. Unaccompanied Airmen report to dorm management at Bldg 296.

links.title: IHG Army Hotels (Moon Hall / Carolina Inn)

sections.title: Gate Access & Fort Liberty Dependencies
sections.body: Pope Field Gate 18 (Manchester) is open Mon-Fri 0500-2100 and closed weekends/holidays. Non-DoD visitors must obtain passes at the Fort Liberty All-American Visitor Control Center (daily 0500-2100) — not at Pope gates. After VCC hours, use the All-American Gate for one-day temporary passes. Verify gate status before travel; GPS may not reflect closures.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Medical care is through Womack Army Medical Center on Fort Liberty. Shopping and commissary are at the South Post complex on Canopy Lane. Outdoor recreation is through Fort Liberty MWR at Smith Lake.
